719-1809-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-1809-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-955-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

851-3129-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2793-3743-4444-5089-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4444-5089-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-2921-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2440-3581-7109-7730.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-7109-7730.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-7060.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

423-765-1437-3819.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-765-1437-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-765-1437-3819.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2921-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6199-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

6848-6849-6922.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
Your deck size is at least 2.
6848-6849-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite and causing you to draw a card.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 4.

3734-3967-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3358-4359-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

38-851-2316.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-851-2316.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1247-1424-2440.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control an Elf or Warrior
1247-1424-2440.easyPrerequisites: Presence of Gond attached to Pili-Pala.
1247-1424-2440.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1424-2440.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elf and Warrior you control.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

56-997-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

4636-5391-5666.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

301-1142-2034-5570.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Putrid Goblin if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Nardole otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Putrid Goblin, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

486-2043-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
486-2043-2556-4276.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Mnemonic Wall to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {9}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

1242-2207-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Elves.
Immaculate Magistrate does not have summoning sickness.
1242-2207-4613.description:
Activate Immaculate Magistrate by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each Elf you control.
Activate Immaculate Magistrate using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Immaculate Magistrate, you may instead target any other creature, and you may also untap them infinitely using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability.

2446-3398-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Living Hive does not have summoning sickness.
Living Hive and Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2446-3398-4050.description:
Increase Living Hive's power or combat damage ouput by any method so it deals at least 7 combat damager per attack.
Declare Living Hive and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive.
Living Hive triggers, creating at least seven 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Living Hive and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Insects, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.
If Living Hive deals at least 8 combat damage per attack, this combo nets infinite Insect tokens and red mana.

2034-3996-4050.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3996-4050.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {W}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Drover.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Drover.
Repeat.

2034-2124-3394.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
2034-2124-3394.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

150-215-1315-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
150-215-1315-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Titania's second ability triggers, creating a 5/3 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Titania by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Titania enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, putting Gaea's Cradle onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1558-4231-4428-4772-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1479-2232-2317-3912.description:
Play Khalni Garden.
Khalni Garden enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama, Cloudstone Curio, and itself.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Dwarven Mine from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dwarven Mine enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Khalni Garden from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dwarven Mine trigger, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
The Dwarf enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Khalni Garden from your hand onto the battlefield.
Khalni Garden enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dwarven Mine from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Khalni Garden trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
The Plant enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.

1309-4305-4377.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Salvager of Secrets.
1309-4305-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat.

364-614-1987-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-614-1987-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
